nav.title: Ikigo c'ubutabazi AI
nav.subtitle: Ubufasha mu ndimi nyinshi hamwe no guhindukira ku muntu.

customer.title: Tangira ikiganiro
customer.consentText: Ndemeje ko iki kiganiro gishobora gutunganywa n'utanga AI. Inyandiko zirabikwa zifunze.
customer.setupHint: Ntibishoboka kugeza umuyobozi atunganye urufunguzo n'utanga AI.
customer.chatEmpty: Ubutumwa buraboneka aha. Ibikorwa bya AI ni inama gusa; nta kwishyura cyangwa guhindura konti bikorwa.
customer.voiceStreamNote: Ijwi ryo mu mucukumbuzi ryoherezwa ku utanga serivisi; OpsCore ntivuga ko ibika amajwi.
customer.voiceRequirement: Ijwi risaba HTTPS, mikoro, kwemera, moderi Realtime n'urufunguzo. Ntabwo ari telefoni.

queue.title: Umurongo wo guhindukira
queue.description: Ibiganiro bishobora guteza akaga cyangwa bisabye umuntu biboneka aha. Umurongo ntabwo ari ihuriro ry'abantu.
queue.replyStorageNote: Ibisubizo by'abantu bibikwa bifunze kandi bigaragara mu nyandiko.

boundaries.title: Imipaka y'ibikorwa
boundaries.automateBody: Kubanza mu ndimi nyinshi, gusobanura, gupima ingorane, kubika inyandiko, gukora umurongo.
boundaries.humanBody: Gusaba umuntu, kwizera guke, ingorane ikomeye, amabwiriza adahari, ikibazo kitemewe, ikirego cy'ibanga.
boundaries.notEnabledBody: PSTN/SIP, WhatsApp, imeyili, telefoni, CRM no kwemeza indimi bisaba utanga serivisi nyakuri n'ibizamini.

messages.qualificationNotice: Nta rurimi rwemejwe kugeza ibizamini by'inyandiko, ASR, TTS n'ijwi byarangiye.
messages.configOk: Igenamiterere rihari. Ihuriro n'ubuziranenge bw'ururimi bisaba ibizamini.
messages.conversationCreated: Ikiganiro gifunze cyakozwe. Ubuziranenge bw'ururimi ntibwemejwe.
messages.handoffQueued: Guhindukira ku muntu byashyizwe mu murongo ({reason}). Ni ubusabe, ntabwo ari ihuriro.
messages.aiResponseFailed: Igisubizo cya AI nticyarangiye. Nta gikorwa cyakozwe. Ushobora gusaba umuntu.
messages.apiUnavailable: API y'ikigo ntiyabonetse. Injira muri OpsCore, hanyuma uvugurure iyi paji.
messages.handoffQueuedQueueOnly: Guhindukira ku muntu byashyizwe mu murongo ({reason}). Umurongo ntugaragaza ko umukozi ahari.
messages.voiceHandoffStopped: Guhindukira ku muntu byashyizwe mu murongo. Ikiganiro cya AI kirahagarara; telefoni ntiyatunganyijwe.
messages.voiceRealtimeError: Utanga Realtime yatanze ikosa. Hagarika ijwi, usuzume igenamiterere, hanyuma ugerageze.
messages.voiceActive: Ijwi rirakora. Saba umuntu igihe icyo ari cyo; bituma umurongo, ntabwo telefoni.
